A layout table renders its rows as list items, and those markers honour the bullets option like any other list

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"bullets\":\"*+-\"}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<table><tr><td>alpha</td><td>beta</td></tr><tr><td><a href=\"/1\">a</a></td><td><a href=\"/2\">b</a></td><td><a href=\"/3\">c</a></td></tr></table>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
